mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate environment reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, increasing valuation multiples and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in low FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL annual change) exceeds 2.5%, the market anticipates aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity risk appetite and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in CPIAUCSL > 2.5% periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signal deteriorating consumer demand, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in GDPC1 and HOUST decline periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 9.0%), a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals worsening labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in UNRATE > 9.0% periods with PAYEMS decline are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) from the prior month indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in INDPRO decline periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 90.0, it signals severe manufacturing distress, triggering equity portfolio rebalancing and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in INDPRO < 90.0 periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In the post-recovery economic regime, a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer spending, reducing corporate revenue forecasts and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in post-recovery RSAFS decline periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS and rise in CPIAUCSL annual change (>2.0%) signals conflicting monetary policy signals, increasing market volatility and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decline and CPIAUCSL annual change > 2.0%
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS decline/CPIAUCSL > 2.0% periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
